title: Staining Cells with IncuCyte Cytolight Rapid Dyes for Flow Cytometry or Fluorescent Microscopy
author: Elinor Gottschalk
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.73nhqme

steps.title: Harvest and wash cells
steps.instruction: Harvest the cells and wash them with 1X PBS.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 350 x g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add IncuCyte Dye
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate IncuCyte Dye based on the cell type used:

substeps.instruction: For pmel-1 T cells: Use 0.11 µM green dye (add 10 µl of 11 µM working stock per 1 ml of cell suspension).
For Jurkat cells: Use 1 µM green dye.
For B16F10 cells: Use 0.11 µM red dye.

steps.title: Incubate cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells at 37 °C for 20 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Wrap the tube in foil and place it in a water bath.
Invert the tube twice during incubation to mix the cells.

steps.title: Wash and quench excess dye
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in PBS at 1 million cells per ml.

substeps.instruction: Add a 6-fold volume of complete media (containing serum) to bind the excess dye.
Centrifuge at 350 x g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Final resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in complete media at the desired concentration.

steps.title: Assay cells
steps.instruction: Analyze the cells using flow cytometry or fluorescence microscopy.

substeps.instruction: For flow cytometry: Use FITC for green dye and APC for red dye.
For fluorescence microscopy: Use FITC filter for green dye and Cy5 filter for red dye.
